about: The zoom bubble's layouts, as a Mac's green button since macOS 15 (docs/adr/0016-windows.mdx, decision 12): WindowProbe's zoom bubble (Bloom's WindowControls, the window-layout capability) with the pointer resting on it opens, half a second on, a menu in a compositor popup named Window layouts: Move & Resize (Left, Right, Top, Bottom and the quarters), Fill & Arrange (Fill, Center and the arrangements) and Return to Previous Size, each row named by its label. Each row chosen lays the window out as the compositor's own tiling does (LayOutSurface, protocol version 50), the rectangles window-tiling asserts at 1280 × 720 with no shell (the work area the whole display, 8 px margins), and Return to Previous Size gives back the frame before the first; an arrangement with no window behind takes its first tile. A long press opens it too; from the keyboard ↓ and Return choose a row and Escape closes it; a press on the bubble still zooms.
